messages:
Alex Chen: heads-up — the console "top api keys by tokens" widget just showed an entry for tenant 'acme-corp' while I'm scoped to 'beta-pilot'. not a cached old view, live query.
Priya Nair: yikes. can you repro steps? is it only that widget or other dashboards too?
Alex Chen: steps: 1) login as beta-pilot org -> 2) open /console/metrics -> 3) view the top-keys widget. saw acme-corp id and their token hash.
Alex Chen: i grabbed the network trace. UI requested /internal/metrics/aggregate?scope=org&window=1h
Jonah Park: @Alex can you paste the response?
Alex Chen: pasted sample response (sanitized):
```
{ "buckets": [ { "key": "acme-corp", "tokens": 12345 }, { "key": "beta-pilot", "tokens": 5432 } ] }
```
Mei Zhang: if a tenant id shows up under a different org's console that's cross-tenant leakage — high severity.
Luis Rivera: quick triage: backend /internal/metrics/aggregate endpoint takes optional tenant_id header but falls back to tenant query across all tenants if header missing. probable bug: frontend sometimes omits header during client-side navigation -> backend aggregates globally.
Priya Nair: so this is a scoping bug in the metrics service, not the UI storing other orgs' data?
Luis Rivera: yep. minimal repro: curl with no X-Tenant header returns global aggregate. with header it filters.
Luis Rivera: example curl:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer ..." \ 
     -H "X-Tenant: beta-pilot" \ 
     'https://internal/api/v1/metrics/aggregate?window=1h'
```
Clara Gomez: omg that means quotas & billing dashboards might expose counts to the wrong orgs too.
Mei Zhang: security impact: leaked token hashes are PII-ish and could let someone target a tenant. escalate.
devops-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: #INC-2026-0427 severity=high — metrics-aggregation-scope-leak
Priya Nair: options: 1) emergency hotfix in metrics service to require X-Tenant (fast) 2) change frontend to always send header (safer but slower) 3) disable widget in console until fixed.
Jonah Park: UX/rollout note — disabling widget is quickest and reversible. but we should be careful with canary -> need to keep dashboards for SRE.
Luis Rivera: root cause SQL: missing WHERE tenant_id = $1 in this aggregation path. patch is 2-line change in repo service/metrics/agg.go: add `WHERE tenant_id = $1` and bind param.
Clara Gomez: can we revoke the telemetry role for the console service account so it can't read cross-tenant rows? quick mitigation.
Mei Zhang: yes, temporary principle-of-least-privilege change is safe. do it now.
Priya Nair: action plan:
- @Luis apply DB patch + run unit tests (canary in staging) — target +1h
- @Clara revoke telemetry read role for console service account (mitigation) — now
- @Jonah disable the top-keys widget on prod console behind a feature flag (rollback easy) — 15m
- @Alex gather full list of exposed dashboards and notify CISO + legal for customer notification decision — now
- @Mei coordinate incident page + severity = high, start postmortem schedule
Luis Rivera: starting patch PR now, will request priority review.
Clara Gomez: revoked console-service telemetry role, confirmed no more global reads from that client.
Jonah Park: feature flag pushed to prod to hide widget; rollouts tool shows 0.5% canary then full — I'm holding the canary.
Alex Chen: i've opened a support ticket template to notify affected customers if legal advises.
Priya Nair: internal debate: do we auto-rotate any exposed keys? that would be noisy. legal to advise.
Mei Zhang: also run a quick scan for other internal endpoints that default to global if header missing. Luis can you add an integration test that asserts tenant header required for all internal metrics endpoints?
Luis Rivera: adding integration test in the PR. will also grep for `WHERE tenant_id` usage.
Clara Gomez: left a note in the incident channel to track quota/billing effects and to check if any customers exceeded quota due to misattributed tokens.
Jonah Park: rollout UX lesson: frontend should use a client wrapper that always attaches X-Tenant and fail loudly in dev if missing. filed DEVEX-1357.
Mei Zhang: summary: scope bug in metrics aggregation allowed cross-tenant telemetry exposure. mitigation: revoke role + hide widget + patch service + tests + postmortem + customer notification follow-up.
Priya Nair: thanks team. prioritize follow-up tasks in the morning incident triage. :thumbsup:
